name: rokctapp_composer
description: Configuration list of active SDKs for the Forex app
_comment_deployment: This file is a template (see README.md in this folder) — it takes effect only once copied to the app repo root as composer.json. CI silently SKIPS composition when the root composer.json is missing — there is no error, the app simply builds without any SDK. The forex domain SDK lives in RokctAI/commerce under forex/ (see forex/README.md there).

sdks.name: base_sdk
sdks._sha256_comment: SHA-256 of base/dart/install.py at core@4793dfa; required by the composer's unpinned-installer gate. Update when upstream install.py changes.
sdks._comment: Shared kernel; provides the app shell templates, the Dio client and the theme tokens. The only SDK forex_sdk imports directly (ADR-005).

sdks.name: telemetry_sdk
sdks._comment: App telemetry: events flow through base_sdk's TelemetryClient.track gateway cmd, with telemetry_sdk owning delivery policy via the TelemetryClient.configure transport seam. Pin = sha256 of core telemetry/dart/install.py as bootstrapped, same value as radio.json's entry.

sdks.name: forex_sdk
sdks._sha256_comment: SHA-256 of forex/dart/install.py at commerce@07427e3; required by the composer's unpinned-installer gate. Update when upstream install.py changes.
sdks._comment: Forex domain SDK — strategy catalog, risk presets, broker-account dashboard. The home SDK: its manifest's app_routes entry overrides replaceMainRoute to the strategy catalog.

sdks.name: auth_sdk
sdks._sha256_comment: SHA-256 of auth/dart/install.py at Users@15d625c; required by the composer's unpinned-installer gate. Update when upstream install.py changes.
sdks._comment: Login/register/reset routes, installed automatically by its own manifest.

sdks.name: corporate_sdk
sdks._sha256_comment: SHA-256 of corporate/dart/install.py at corporate@aa23ff0; required by the composer's unpinned-installer gate. Update when upstream install.py changes.
sdks._comment: Policy/terms pages reached from auth's login footer. Any composition including auth_sdk needs it.

sdks.name: users_sdk
sdks._sha256_comment: SHA-256 of users/dart/install.py at Users@15d625c; required by the composer's unpinned-installer gate. Update when upstream install.py changes.

sdks.name: wallet_sdk
sdks._sha256_comment: SHA-256 of wallet/dart/install.py at pay@59bd4f8; required by the composer's unpinned-installer gate. Update when upstream install.py changes.
sdks._comment: Present so the host's ForexWalletBalanceSource adapter has something to read. forex_sdk does NOT import it — it declares a one-method read-only interface instead, deliberately not depending on WalletRepositoryFacade, which bundles two money-moving writes.

sdks.name: subscriptions_sdk
sdks._sha256_comment: SHA-256 of subscriptions/dart/install.py at agent@7c3dddb; required by the composer's unpinned-installer gate. Update when upstream install.py changes.
sdks._comment: Backs the host's ForexAccessStatusSource and ForexSubscriptionStatusSource adapters. Not imported by forex_sdk.

sdks.name: payments_sdk
sdks._sha256_comment: SHA-256 of payments/dart/install.py at pay@59bd4f8; required by the composer's unpinned-installer gate. Update when upstream install.py changes.
sdks._comment: Backs the host's ForexPlanCatalog adapter, including startCheckout. Not imported by forex_sdk.

sdks.name: products_sdk
sdks._sha256_comment: SHA-256 of products/dart/install.py at commerce@07427e3; required by the composer's unpinned-installer gate. Update when upstream install.py changes.
sdks._comment: Transitive dependency of users_sdk; not used directly by any forex feature.

sdks.name: merchants_sdk
sdks._sha256_comment: SHA-256 of merchants/dart/install.py at commerce@07427e3; required by the composer's unpinned-installer gate. Update when upstream install.py changes.
sdks._comment: Mutual dependency of products_sdk; not used directly by any forex feature.

sdks.name: desktop_sdk
sdks._comment: TEMPORARY (desktop testing convenience, revert candidate): added to every app profile so all composed apps pull desktop support and can be viewed/tested on desktop. Pin = sha256 of hardware desktop/dart/install.py at main head 84aa6ed, same value as supacharge.json's entry.

sdks.name: hms_sdk
sdks._comment: Huawei Mobile Services support, built like desktop_sdk (SDK module, not productFlavors). Dart-side: DeviceServices ({gms, hms, neither} detection, cached, fail-open to gms) and an order-30 boot hook that, ONLY on GMS-free HMS-capable devices, boots Push Kit and registers the HMS push token through the same api.user.register_device_token gateway cmd the FCM token uses (provider 'hms'). No installs - the BUILD_HMS-gated AGConnect Gradle wiring lives statically in core's android template, default-off. Strict no-op in every plain GMS build.
